steps.content: The explosion tore through the second floor. Given what's kept up there, there's only one thing the target could be: the Monolith prototype in Hilda's room.
[Scene Change: Corridor]
By the time you reach the upstairs corridor, the gunfire is sputtering out. The perimeter attack has been quelled, the guards' shots growing isolated, then ceasing altogether.
In the ensuing quiet, your eyes strain against the darkness. A single, vague silhouette is collapsed on the floor ahead.
The lights flicker, then flood the corridor with a harsh, steady glow, allowing you to make out the face.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Johnson?!
[Scene Change: could be Main Hall]

The scene is one of utter devastation. The electrical equipment at the corridor's end is shredded. A nest of wiring has been blown apart, its core still smoldering, tendrils of black smoke coiling toward the ceiling. The walls are scarred with soot.

And there, directly beneath the shattered electrical box, is Johnson. He lies on his back, an ordinary military knife driven deep into his chest. A pool of fresh, shockingly red blood is still spreading beneath him, gleaming under the emergency lights.

His eyes are frozen wide in a final mask of terror. His right hand is twisted into a desperate, clawing gesture, while his left hand is clenched in a death grip around... a single, severed piece of copper wire.
A choked scream escapes Casey at the sight of the body. She stumbles backward, nearly fainting, before Manphist lunges forward to catch her.

steps.speaker: Casey
steps.content: No... Johnson... No... Who did this? Tell me who did this!
Emotion overwhelms her. She lurches to her feet and stumbles toward Johnson's body, the stunned hesitation of the others granting her a tragic passage.

steps.speaker: Casey
steps.content: This knife... it's Marlo's. I saw it on him yesterday, during his argument with Horne!
Her gaze instantly locks on Marlo. His face darkens as his hand goes instinctively to the empty sheath at his waist.

steps.speaker: Marlo
steps.content: Tch. With all the shooting and chaos earlier, some rat probably swiped it in the dark.

steps.speaker: Casey
steps.content: You're a professional! You expect me to believe someone could lift your knife without you knowing? And how convenient that you just happened to be on the second floor when the lights came back on!
Casey steps forward, her gaze intense and bloodshot from a sleepless night, pinning Marlo in place.

steps.speaker: Casey
steps.content: You didn't leave it on purpose. You dropped it because ${PlayerName} cut off your escape! You knew you'd be trapped if you didn't run, so you fled. And now you're lying about it being stolen!

steps.speaker: Marlo
steps.content: Hey, Hilda. You just gonna stand there and let her run her mouth?
Ignoring their argument, Hilda strides to the blast site, her eyes scanning the charred plastic fragments and fine metal powder littering the ground.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Nolaine, analyze the composition of this powder.

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: Let me see... Looks like a crude ammonium nitrate mixture. Homemade. Low yield, but enough to damage the junction and cause the outage. The residue contains copper shavings and fragmented engineering plastic.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: So, Johnson was sabotaging the electrical box before he was attacked. He succeeded, and then someone stopped him. Permanently.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: But why kill him? And why leave the body at the scene of the crime?
Her gaze sweeps across Marlo's empty knife sheath.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: One possibility is an intervention. A would-be hero discovered the sabotage and killed him to stop it. But it seems we have no such clever "detective" among us.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: That leaves the second scenario. The killer was an accomplice. The murder was to silence him.

steps.speaker: Casey
steps.content: That's not true...! Johnson would never do this! He was loyal to the metropoles! One of you must have forced him into it, then killed him to cover your tracks!

steps.speaker: Marlo
steps.content: ...I didn't kill him. When I got here, he was already on the ground.

steps.speaker: Casey
steps.content: Then why were you looking for him? When the shooting started, who would think to check the electrical box?!

steps.speaker: Marlo
steps.content: Now that you mention it... Huck was the one who asked me where Johnson was... Hey, was this your doing?!

steps.speaker: Huck
steps.content: Th-that's a vicious lie! You're the one caught with an empty sheath, and now you're trying to pin this on me?!

steps.speaker: Casey
steps.content: Huck, why did you send Marlo after him? Did you know what he was doing? Or did you put him up to it?

steps.speaker: Casey
steps.content: Johnson didn't know a thing about electrical systems! Someone gave him the tools, told him what to do... Let's see if the copper wire in his hand matches the spool in your toolkit. That should clear things up, shouldn't it?
Huck goes perfectly still. A tremor runs through him, and his gaze snaps involuntarily to the toolkit at his hip.
In the breathless silence that follows, Manphist carefully clears his throat, the sound cutting through the tension.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: Perhaps a suggestion. While we cannot ascertain the true culprit at this moment, might I propose that Marlo and Huck surrender their weapons first?

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: A reasonable proposal. Please hand over your weapons.
Marlo's glare is sharp enough to shatter steel. A muscle twitches in his jaw as, with deliberate slowness, he opens his jacket and unbuckles his gun belt.
Huck's face bleeds of all color, leaving it a mask of stark fear.

steps.speaker: Casey
steps.content: What are you waiting for, Huck?

steps.speaker: Huck
steps.content: I told you, I didn't kill him! I'm not a murderer!
In a flash of motion, Huck wrenches a screwdriver from his belt and hurls himself at Casey, the closest target, shouting frantically.

steps.speaker: Huck
steps.content: Fine! Yes, I went to see Johnson! I invested everything in his private fund! I just wanted my money back! I gave him the tools to escape, that's all!
The sudden aggression is all the provocation Marlo needs; his weapon is already raised, his aim steady on Huck.

steps.speaker: Marlo
steps.content: Drop it, Huck! Now!

steps.speaker: Casey
steps.content: Huck, you fool! Killing me won't save you!

steps.speaker: Huck
steps.content: I confess! I sold information! I leaked the Cryptography Department's location! But don't you dare act high and mighty! None of you are clean!

steps.speaker: Huck
steps.content: You! How many bodies did you climb over to get where you are in the gang? How many families? And you—

steps.speaker: Huck
steps.content: You twist the truth, you ruin lives with your headlines! And you!

steps.speaker: Huck
steps.content: You fabricated the grounds to have your own comrades eliminated! Don't any of you see their faces when you close your eyes?!
His hand jerks violently. The screwdriver flashes, gashing deep into Casey's neck. A torrent of blood immediately streams down her skin.

steps.speaker: Huck
steps.content: We're all dead if we stay... Just let me go... Let me go! Hilda!
Hilda's gaze coolly assesses Huck and the hostage, Casey. She takes a deliberate step back, seemingly clearing a path.
But in that same movement, her hand makes a subtle, deliberate gesture meant only for you.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Huck, think logically. I can let you pass, but you won't survive the journey back to DisCity. When he goes down the stairs.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Surrender is your best option. Follow my lead.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Is this how you want to reunite with your family?
Three.
Cold sweat and Casey's blood smear together as Huck drags her limp form, stumbling toward the stairs. He's focused on his escape.
Two.
Meanwhile, you're already in position.
One!
Swiftly, you snatch Marlo's discarded gun from the floor. But you don't aim at Huck, the dangerous, moving target. Instead, you fire at Marlo!

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Now!
Hilda's shout rings out almost simultaneously with the gunshot! In the split second Huck is distracted by Marlo's scream, she explodes into motion, lunging at him.

She crosses the short distance like a phantom, her right elbow driving with brutal precision into the soft tissue beneath his ribs. A strangled gasp escapes Huck as his vision tunnels. His grip fails.

In one fluid, vicious motion, Hilda wrenches the weapon from his hand, drives a knee into his lower back, and slams him into the floorboards. The cold, hard kiss of a gun barrel presses against his temple.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Don't move. One twitch, and I'll make you wish you were dead.

Meanwhile, you step calmly past the chaos and send Marlo's pistol skittering into a distant corner with a precise kick.
He clutches his blood-soaked shoulder, glaring up at you with pure venom, but he's too weakened to do anything more.
Helene and Manphist stand utterly still, frozen by the lightning-fast reversal.
The hall stinks of dust and iron. Johnson's corpse, Casey's grievous injury, Marlo's bleeding shoulder, and Huck pinned beneath Hilda—together, they form a tableau from a nightmare.

Hilda kneels on Huck's back, her weapon unwavering. Her breath comes in quick, controlled puffs, but her eyes are razor-sharp. When her gaze flicks to yours, you catch a clear, unmistakable flash of approval.
